trigger: missing export of cipher constructors/factories from `src/ciphers/index.ts`

trigger: cycle detection implemented via naive DFS instead of Kahn’s algorithm for topological sort, causing O(n²) worst-case on large graphs

trigger: missing `if __name__ == '__main__':` block or incorrect entry point registration in `glyphdb.py`
